sentences.text:
Applicant has filed this first bail application under Section 439 of CrPC for grant of regular bail as he
was arrested in connection with Crime No. 55 of 2023 registered at Police Station Amlipadar,
District - Gariyaband (C.G.) for offence punishable under Section 376 (2)(n), 376 (3) of I.P.C.,
Section 6 of Pocso Act, 2012 & Section 3 (2)(v) of Schedule Caste and Schedule Tribe (Prevention
of Atrocities) Act, 1989.
2.

Case of the prosecution is that, on 20.08.2023 father of victim lodged report stating that applicant committed sexual intercourse with her minor child due to which she became pregnant and also gave birth to a child on 16.08.2023.
Based on the report, aforementioned crime was registered and applicant was arrested on 20.08.2023.
3. Pursuant to notice issued by this Court, victim along with her father appeared before this Court through virtual mode from DLSA Raipur and they raised objection in grant of bail to applicant.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for applicant submits that applicant has been falsely implicated in the aforementioned crime, he has not committed any offence of any nature as alleged.
Even if the allegations is taken to be correct, it appears that report has been lodged with inordinate delay.
The charge-sheet has been filed and in the charge-sheet, there is no material to suggest that applicant is biological father of the child and therefore, no case would be made out.

He further argued that to prove the age of victim to be below 18 years, prosecution has only collected admission register of Government School which prima facie appears to be interpolated and cannot be relied upon.
5. Learned State counsel opposes the submission made by learned counsel for applicant and submits that from the admission register, age of victim on the date of incident was less than 15 years.

In the statement of victim recorded under Section 161 of Cr.P.C as also evidence recorded before learned Court below, victim has stated that it was applicant who committed sexual intercourse with her on many occasions on the pretext of marriage.
6. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and also perused the documents enclosed with bail application.

7. Taking into consideration the submission of learned counsel for the respective parties, nature of allegations, as also the age of victim as stated by learned State counsel based on the admission register to be less than 15 years, I do not find present to be a fit case to enlarge the applicant on bail.
8. Accordingly, the bail application is dismissed.

9. At this stage, learned counsel for applicant submits that applicant is in jail since 20.08.2023,
hence, learned Trial Court be directed to expedite the trial.
10.
In view of the above, learned Trial Court is directed to expedite the trial.

Sd/-
 (Parth Prateem Sahu)
